654-2577-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3899-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3899-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

147-5929-7884.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sygg's Command
147-5929-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sygg's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Sygg's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5929-7884.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

1632-1978-5793-7008.description:
Activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Stonespeaker Crystal which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1251-1368-2033-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-2033-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2092-2281-4549-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Saffi Eriksdotter, adding {B}.
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-7430--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

222-527-4742-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

679-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-4067-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

628-3967-7194.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

3685-5330-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-5330-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-1483-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Weaponcraft Enthusiast ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-1483-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2921-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

670-1619-3086.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
You have the highest life total.
670-1619-3086.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in "Tomb of Annihilation" in the "Veils of Fear" room.
670-1619-3086.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Radiant Solar and two other nontoken creatures until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Lagrella and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land or lose 2 life.
Lagrella leaves the battlefield, returning Radiant Solar and the two other nontoken creatures from exile to the battlefield.
Radiant Solar and the two creatures enter the battlefield, triggering Radiant Solar three times.
Resolve the first Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a 4/4 The Atropal legendary creature token, and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Radiant Solar and two other nontoken creatures until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Trapped Entry" room of the Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the second Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to lose 2 life unless they discard a card.
Repeat from step 4.

233-714-2899.description: When a land enters the battlefield, it becomes a Swamp due to Kormus Bell. This then causes it to become a 0/0 creature due to Urborg and Kaervek, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.

2457-3000-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1-2275-5014-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

710-997-3055.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-997-3055.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

586-2146-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

186-3076-4289-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
186-3076-4289-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

837-2440-3012-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Humans and/or Monks.
837-2440-3012-3263.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Lotus-Eye Mystics to your hand.
Cast Lotus-Eye Mystics by paying {4}.
When Lotus-Eye Mystics enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Lotus-Eye Mystics trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Humans and/or Monks, this combo nets infinite mana.

1132-1594-3263-4365-4761.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {W}{U}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1694-2560-3059.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

618-3908.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double is a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
618-3908.description:
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste that will be sacrificed at the next end step.
The Spark Double token enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Kiki-Jiki with an additional +1/+1 counter.
Activate the Spark Double token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste, exile that token at the end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
